name: qa-saas-platform
description: QA SaaS Platform with AI Agents - Complete solution for QA engineers

scripts.api:prisma:migrate: cd api && npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.build: npm run api:build && npm run web:build && npm run extension:build
scripts.test: npm run api:test && npm run web:test
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd api && npm install && cd ../web && npm install && cd ../extension && npm install
scripts.workflow:agents: concurrently "npm run workflow:agent:fda" "npm run workflow:agent:sdet" "npm run workflow:agent:qae" "npm run workflow:agent:tla" "npm run workflow:agent:poa"

author: AgenticaQaFramework
